def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import glob
    import pandas as pd

    paths = glob.glob('data/environment/input/water-body-testing-*.csv')
    if not paths:
        raise FileNotFoundError('No files matched data/environment/input/water-body-testing-*.csv')

    dfs = []
    for p in sorted(paths):
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
        df['sourceFile'] = p.split('/')[-1]
        dfs.append(df)

    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True, sort=False)
    return out

def process(loadAllYears) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadAllYears.copy()

    # Keep requested year window (2002-2023 inclusive)
    # Prefer the explicit Year column (present in files) rather than parsing filename.
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2002) & (df['Year'] <= 2023)].copy()

    # Marine beaches: Beach Type Description == 'Marine'
    if 'Beach Type Description' not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected column 'Beach Type Description' not found. Columns: {list(df.columns)}")
    marine = df[df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('marine')].copy()

    # Exceedance: treat Violation=yes as exceedance
    if 'Violation' not in marine.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected column 'Violation' not found. Columns: {list(marine.columns)}")
    viol = marine['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

    # Only keep rows with interpretable yes/no
    is_yes = viol.isin(['yes', 'y', 'true', '1'])
    is_no = viol.isin(['no', 'n', 'false', '0'])
    valid = marine[is_yes | is_no].copy()

    exceed_rate = is_yes[is_yes | is_no].mean()  # mean of boolean = proportion

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'avgHistoricalExceedanceRate': float(exceed_rate),
        'nRowsMarineTotal': int(marine.shape[0]),
        'nRowsMarineValidViolation': int(valid.shape[0]),
        'nYears': int(valid['Year'].nunique(dropna=True))
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute average historical exceedance rate for marine beaches (2002–2023): filter by numeric Year between 2002 and 2023 (inclusive); subset Beach Type Description == 'Marine'; interpret exceedance as Violation in {yes,y,true,1} vs non-exceedance in {no,n,false,0}; drop rows with other/blank Violation; exceedance rate = mean(exceedance boolean) across all remaining marine-beach samples; output single-row table with avgHistoricalExceedanceRate and diagnostics (nRowsMarineTotal, nRowsMarineValidViolation, nYears).
